newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Meralco rises 12.5 pct by early trade.
newsitem.headline: Meralco rises 12.5 pct by early trade.

text.p: Manila Electric Co (Meralco) B shares rose 12.5 percent to 126 pesos on early Wednesday session after the Securities and Exchange Commission denied it would allow foreigners to invest in cheaper A shares, brokers said.
"Investors who sold off their shares yesterday are buying them back now," one broker said.
Meralco B was hit by heavy selling on Tuesday after reports of a pending change in the policy regarding A shares which are sold exclusively to local investors.
The SEC later denied the reports saying it has no intention to allow foreigners to buy into A shares.
Meralco B is the most heavily traded stock so far with turnover of over 105 million shares.
